worktree_policy.first_execution: new session creates a fresh worktree and task branch per repository from integrated local main
worktree_policy.later_sessions: resume the same V3.2 task worktrees; never old V3 trees

delete_owned: old worktrees and merged task branches
retirement_policy.new_resources: fresh isolated resources under V3.2; do not migrate or restore old synthetic data

deadline_policy: Complete a task early and immediately advance to the next READY task. Task minutes and command120 minutes are warning thresholds, not automatic termination deadlines. On overrun warn, record elapsed time/progress/cause/next action, and continue; diagnose lack of progress rather than killing or restarting solely due to elapsed time. No session cutoff or remaining-window blocker. Preserve original start times and warning history. Request human help only for a genuine external prerequisite. Disk, cost, credential, permission, observation and repeated-failure safeguards remain in force.
initialization: Task TODO fields below are the first-execution template only. Later execution resumes external state.json and valid V3.2 receipts without resetting existing PASS. Earlier V3 scoped PASS is not automatically inherited; R00 reconciles the retirement handoff only on first execution.

startup_wave.app_next: A02 after the App writer is released; early overlap only if read-only and build/test state is isolated

disk_policy.cleanup: remove owned rebuildable scratch and duplicate builds after successful attempts; preserve compact receipts, necessary redacted raw logs and hashes; compress logs without truncating failures

candidate_policy: Bind source/dependency/schema/profile/runner/oracle input closure. Reuse unchanged PASS. Invalidate only affected closure. Q01 and Q02 must share frozen inputs without an intervening fix.

commit_policy.code_tasks: focused checks plus three independent reviews, explicit staging, normal hooks, one complete logical change per commit

vendor.secret_storage: restricted external source or environment only; never repository/argv/receipt/log

entrypoint_policy: Commands below are existing entrypoints or discovery commands, not blanket acceptance. After discovery bind exact cases/args to every oracle before executing. Track original elapsed time, warn on overrun and continue; no guessed harnesses or old all-in-one gate. If a required case lacks a runner, implement focused coverage as part of that task and review it.
